enchantments.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Goldcurse: This weapon applies a dangerous, golden curse to enemies struck! They must succeed on a DC17 Fortitude save on each Critical hit or be Paralyzed by solid gold.
Entropic 2: This weapon is intensely powerful, and crackles with destructive, unpredictable magic. It deals an additional 2d6 untyped damage on each hit.
Wounding 1: This weapon saps the health from your enemies, dealing 1 Constitution damage on each hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
